period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) as at 2025-06-30. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY 2025 (as published in the FY2025 annual report's own 'EVALUATION OF THE CONSOLIDATED QUARTERLY FINANCIALS By the Board Audit Committee' table), NOT discrete-quarter figures -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix; discrete-quarter figures were not computed by subtraction, per project convention (same as CITYBANK). Table title explicitly says 'Consolidated' ('EVALUATION OF THE CONSOLIDATED QUARTERLY FINANCIALS By the Board Audit Committee'). Dec-31-2025 column cross-checked against the already-stored 2025_Q4.json (sourced from mtb-annual-report-2025.txt (own report)): total_assets, gross_loans, total_deposits, total_liabilities, total_equity, operating_income, tax_expense and profit_after_tax all match to within ordinary whole-million rounding (largest drift <0.08%) -- no discrepancy found for 2025. Balance-sheet identity (Total Property and Assets = Total Liabilities + Total Capital & Shareholders' Equity + Non-Controlling Interest) validated exactly (max drift BDT 0.01m, pure decimal-rounding noise) for all four quarters of 2025, including this Q2. Non-Controlling Interest (~BDT 0.13-0.14m) is omitted as its own line item here (rounds to 0 in whole millions) but is included in the identity check above. Cumulative Total Operating Income, Net Profit After Tax and Interest Income all increase monotonically Q1->Q2->Q3 for 2025 (Q1=5,610.72, Q2=10,954.56, Q3=16,168.19 for operating income; Q1=850.48, Q2=1,161.08, Q3=2,038.43 for net profit after tax) -- no violation. Cumulative 'Tax including deferred tax' swings sharply -- 184.64 (Q1) -> 259.63 (Q2) -> -1,500.88 (Q3, a large net tax credit) -> -295.97 (Q4, per 2025_Q4.json's own 'fy2025_negative_tax_expense' insight) -- but Net Profit After Tax still increases monotonically Q1->Q2->Q3->Q4 throughout (850.48 -> 1,161.08 -> 2,038.43 -> 3,392.91), so no violation.
